extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism/adjudication summary from XML sections, figure captions, and methods. Mechanism is kept as contextual/conditional evidence and not promoted to quantitative direct mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Xentry variants are cell-penetrating peptides with uptake visualized in endosomes/cytoplasm and a reported dependence on HSPG/syndecan context from this paper and its cited prior Xentry study.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Xentry/LCLRPVG and truncated or substituted variants
mechanism_claims.limitations: The current paper provides uptake localization and cell-specificity context; it does not fully resolve the molecular trigger for uptake or endosomal release.

source_locators.locator: xml:sec=6:Truncated and D-isomeric forms of Xentry are unable to penetrate resting lymphocytes

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The LCLR/LCL motif and cysteine-containing hydrophobic head are source-supported determinants of cell-penetrating activity, with substitution or truncation changing qualitative uptake across cancer cell lines.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Table 1 is qualitative visual scoring, not a normalized MIC/EC50-style potency table.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Two activatable Xentry constructs were not taken up until MMP-9 cleavage, supporting protease-gated cell penetration in MCF-7 cells.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Local material supports qualitative MMP-9-gated uptake; exact fluorescence intensities are figure-only and not tabulated.
